title: SpaceX catches Starship’s upper section on return to Earth for first time

ai.summary: SpaceX successfully caught the upper section of its Starship rocket during the 15th test flight, marking a milestone in reusable launch vehicle development, though the lower section failed to be recovered.

facts.claim: SpaceX has successfully caught the upper section of its giant Starship rocket on its return to Earth for the first time
facts.quote: SpaceX has successfully caught the upper section of its giant Starship rocket on its return to Earth for the first time, marking a major milestone in the company's efforts to develop a fully reusable launch vehicle, the BBC reported.

facts.claim: The spacecraft, known as the Ship, returned to Earth after a 22-and-a-half-hour flight
facts.quote: The spacecraft, known as the Ship, returned to Earth after a 22-and-a-half-hour flight and was caught by mechanical arms, nicknamed 'chopsticks', attached to the launch tower at the company's Starbase facility in Boca Chica, Texas.

facts.claim: The successful catch took place at around 15:20 local time on Saturday
facts.quote: The successful catch took place at around 15:20 local time on Saturday, drawing loud cheers from SpaceX employees watching the operation.

facts.claim: The attempt to catch the lower section, known as the Super Heavy booster, was aborted shortly after Friday's launch
facts.quote: The attempt to catch the lower section, known as the Super Heavy booster, was aborted shortly after Friday's launch. The booster was diverted towards the ocean, where it exploded above the water.

facts.claim: SpaceX chief Elon Musk later said on X that the booster was 'slightly low on fuel'
facts.quote: SpaceX chief Elon Musk later said on X that the booster was "slightly low on fuel".

facts.claim: The 124-metre-tall Starship rocket had lifted off from the Texas launchpad at 16:47 local time on Friday
facts.quote: The 124-metre-tall Starship rocket had lifted off from the Texas launchpad at 16:47 local time on Friday.

facts.claim: This was the 15th test flight of Starship and the first in which SpaceX attempted to recover both sections of the rocket
facts.quote: This was the 15th test flight of Starship and the first in which SpaceX attempted to recover both sections of the rocket.

facts.claim: SpaceX aims to make both sections fully reusable, allowing the rocket to fly repeatedly and significantly reduce the cost of space launches
facts.quote: SpaceX aims to make both sections fully reusable, allowing the rocket to fly repeatedly and significantly reduce the cost of space launches.
